description: Hunting, fishing, trapping, game processing, defence and reloading options for Northern Ontario. utility = survival usefulness 0–10 in this region. legal.status is the possession class: legal (no licence), pal, rpal, prohibited, or licence-to-use. legal.useLicence = licence needed to hunt/fish/trap with it. Canadian firearm classes change by Order in Council: lastVerified is blank until YOU check each entry against the RCMP Firearms Reference Table and current Ontario regulations.

records.name: Bolt-action .22 LR rifle (e.g. CZ 457, Savage Mark II)
records.description: The most useful survival gun for grouse, hare, squirrel and dispatching trapped animals. Quiet, cheap ammo, light.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.
legal.note: Must not be used on big game.

records.coldNote: Rimfire can misfire more in deep cold; bolt actions shrug off thickened lube.
records.maintenance: Low. Clean every few hundred rounds.

records.name: Semi-auto .22 LR rifle (e.g. Ruger 10/22)
records.description: Fast follow-up shots, huge parts support.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.coldNote: Use lithium/dry lube below −20 °C or it can short-cycle.

records.name: Bolt-action .22 WMR / .17 HMR rifle
records.description: More reach for fox, coyote, beaver. Ammo pricier and scarcer.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.name: 12-gauge pump shotgun (e.g. Remington 870, Mossberg 500)
records.description: Most versatile single gun: birdshot for grouse/ducks, slugs for moose at short range and bears, buckshot for defence. Ammo everywhere in the north.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.
legal.note: Long guns with barrels under 457 mm (18 in) or overall under 660 mm are restricted or prohibited.

records.coldNote: Very reliable in cold if kept nearly dry of oil.

records.name: 12-gauge single-shot break-action
records.description: Cheap, simple, light. One shot.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.coldNote: Almost nothing to freeze.

records.name: 12-gauge semi-auto hunting shotgun (e.g. Beretta A300, Benelli Montefeltro)
records.description: Softer recoil, fast follow-ups for waterfowl.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.
legal.note: Some semi-auto shotgun models were named in prohibition orders — check the exact model in the FRT.

records.coldNote: Gas/inertia systems can stiffen in deep cold: clean and run dry.

records.name: 20-gauge pump or single-shot
records.description: Lighter, good for smaller shooters. Ammo less common than 12 ga.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.name: Combination gun: .22 LR over 20 ga or .410 (e.g. Savage 42, Chiappa)
records.description: Classic trapline/bush gun: rimfire for small game, shotgun for flying birds.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.coldNote: Break-action, very simple.

records.name: Rifle/shotgun combination (e.g. 12 ga over .308 or .223)
records.description: One gun for birds and big game. Heavy, rare, costly.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.name: Bolt-action .308 Win rifle
records.description: Enough for moose with good bullets; short action, common ammo.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.coldNote: Bolt actions are the most cold-reliable.

records.name: Bolt-action .30-06 rifle
records.description: Classic moose and bear cartridge; very common in Northern Ontario stores.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.name: Bolt-action .270 Win rifle
records.description: Flat-shooting deer/moose cartridge. Lighter bullets than .30 cals.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.name: Bolt-action .300 Win Mag rifle
records.description: Long-range moose. Heavy recoil, expensive ammo.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.name: Lee-Enfield .303 British
records.description: Rugged surplus military rifle, historically common in the north. Ammo less common now.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.name: Lever-action .30-30 Win (e.g. Marlin 336, Winchester 94)
records.description: Handy bush rifle for deer, black bear, moose inside 150 m. Ammo stocked everywhere.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.coldNote: Keep the action clean of thick grease.

records.name: Lever-action .45-70 Govt
records.description: Heavy bullet for bear defence and moose at short range.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.name: Lever-action .357/.44 Magnum carbine
records.description: Light and handy; deer-capable at short range. Shares ammo with revolvers.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.name: SKS (7.62×39)
records.description: Robust semi-auto, cheap surplus. Ammo moderately available.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.
legal.note: Its status has been debated in Parliament and could change: check the FRT before buying.

records.coldNote: Clean preservative out of the firing pin channel or it can slam-fire.

records.name: Semi-auto hunting rifle, non-restricted (e.g. Browning BAR in .308/.30-06)
records.description: Fast follow-ups on moose or bear.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.
legal.note: Check each model in the Firearms Reference Table: many semi-autos were reclassified in 2020 and 2024.

records.coldNote: Gas systems need care in cold.

records.name: Muzzleloader, percussion/inline .50
records.description: Powder, ball and caps are easy to store. Special hunting seasons.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.coldNote: Damp powder = misfire. Keep caps dry.

records.name: Flintlock muzzleloader (replica)
records.description: Needs only flint, black powder and lead. Slow, weather-sensitive.

legal.consequence: Flintlock, wheel-lock and matchlock replicas are usually 'antique firearms' (no licence to possess), but still need safe storage and a hunting licence to hunt.
legal.note: Antique status depends on the exact design. Verify.

records.coldNote: Damp kills it.

records.name: AR-15 platform rifle (.223/5.56)
records.description: Light, accurate, modular. Named in the May 2020 prohibition order.

legal.consequence: Prohibited: possession by anyone not grandfathered or covered by an amnesty/compensation program is a criminal offence (Criminal Code s. 91/92/95), with possible prison and lifetime firearms prohibition. PAL revoked.
legal.note: Prohibited by Order in Council (May 2020). Amnesty and compensation program terms have changed several times.

records.coldNote: Direct-impingement needs lube even in cold.

records.name: Ruger Mini-14 (.223)
records.description: Ranch rifle, reliable. Named in the May 2020 prohibition order.

legal.consequence: Prohibited: possession by anyone not grandfathered or covered by an amnesty/compensation program is a criminal offence (Criminal Code s. 91/92/95), with possible prison and lifetime firearms prohibition. PAL revoked.
legal.note: Prohibited by Order in Council (May 2020).

records.name: Rifles over 10,000 J muzzle energy or 20 mm+ bore (e.g. .50 BMG)
records.description: Huge, heavy, ammo scarce. Low survival value.

legal.consequence: Prohibited: possession by anyone not grandfathered or covered by an amnesty/compensation program is a criminal offence (Criminal Code s. 91/92/95), with possible prison and lifetime firearms prohibition. PAL revoked.
legal.note: Prohibited class since May 2020.

records.name: Semi-auto 9 mm handgun (barrel over 105 mm)
records.description: Limited role in the bush: low power for bears, legal carry needs a rare wilderness Authorization to Carry.

legal.consequence: Restricted: requires RPAL, registration, Authorization to Transport. National handgun freeze (Oct 2022) blocks most new purchases and transfers. Unlicensed possession = Criminal Code offence.
legal.note: Handgun transfer freeze since Oct 21, 2022.

records.name: Magnum revolver .357/.44 (barrel over 105 mm)
records.description: Trapline bear gun where an Authorization to Carry is held.

legal.consequence: Restricted: requires RPAL, registration, Authorization to Transport. National handgun freeze (Oct 2022) blocks most new purchases and transfers. Unlicensed possession = Criminal Code offence.
legal.note: Handgun transfer freeze since Oct 21, 2022.

records.name: Handguns with barrel 105 mm or less, or .25/.32 calibre
records.description: Concealable handguns. Prohibited except for grandfathered owners.

legal.consequence: Prohibited: possession by anyone not grandfathered or covered by an amnesty/compensation program is a criminal offence (Criminal Code s. 91/92/95), with possible prison and lifetime firearms prohibition. PAL revoked.
legal.note: Prohibited class (Criminal Code 12(6.1)). Grandfathered owners only.

records.name: Air rifle under 152 m/s (500 fps) or under 5.7 J
records.description: Pellet rifle for squirrels and pests. Very quiet.

legal.consequence: No licence to possess (must be 18+ to buy). Treated as a firearm under the Criminal Code if used in a crime.
legal.note: Using air guns for hunting in Ontario is restricted. Check the regulations.

records.coldNote: Springs and seals stiffen in cold; CO2 fails in cold.

records.name: Air rifle over 152 m/s and over 5.7 J (e.g. .25 PCP)
records.description: Powerful pellet rifle; needs a pump or tank to refill.

legal.consequence: Possession without a valid PAL is a Criminal Code offence. Unsafe storage/transport is also an offence.

records.coldNote: PCP seals can leak in cold.

records.name: Compound bow (50–70 lb)
records.description: Silent; arrows reusable. Takes lots of practice.

legal.consequence: No licence to own. Hunting licence (and bow season rules) to hunt.

records.coldNote: Strings and cams can be stiff in deep cold.

records.name: Recurve or longbow (45–60 lb)
records.description: Simplest, repairable, can make arrows in the field.

legal.consequence: No licence to own. Hunting licence to hunt.

records.name: Crossbow (standard, over 500 mm, two-handed)
records.description: Easier to learn than a bow. Slow to reload.

legal.consequence: No licence to own. Hunting licence to hunt; crossbows are allowed in Ontario bow seasons.

records.coldNote: Lubricate rail lightly; strings stiffen.

records.name: Crossbow 500 mm or shorter, or designed to fire with one hand
records.description: Pistol crossbows: little survival value.

legal.consequence: Prohibited weapon: possession is a Criminal Code offence.
legal.note: Prohibited weapon (Criminal Code regulations).

records.name: Slingshot with steel shot
records.description: Light and cheap; hard to be accurate.

legal.consequence: Legal to own. Not a permitted hunting method in Ontario (verify).
legal.note: Not listed as a legal small-game hunting method.

records.coldNote: Rubber bands go brittle in cold: carry spares.

records.name: Hare snares (20–22 gauge brass/steel wire)
records.description: Highest calorie return for effort in winter. Set on runs, 10 cm off the snow.

legal.consequence: Snaring hare needs a small game licence and is limited to north of the French and Mattawa rivers. Other snaring needs a trapping licence.
legal.note: Snares must be checked regularly.

records.sustainability: Hare populations cycle every ~10 years. Ease off in crash years, or you will clean out survivors.

records.name: Body-grip trap 110/120 (muskrat, mink, marten)
records.description: Muskrat: set in runs and push-ups. Marten: elevated box set.

legal.consequence: Trapping licence required (Ontario trapper education + registered trapline or landowner permission). Must be a certified humane trap.
legal.note: Body-grip traps can catch pets: place carefully.

records.coldNote: Can freeze open/shut: wax and keep dry.
records.sustainability: Muskrat breed fast; marten are slow. Rotate areas.

records.name: Body-grip trap 330 (beaver)
records.description: Beaver: set in channels or at castor mounds. A large beaver is 10+ kg of fatty meat.

legal.consequence: Trapping licence required. Certified trap rules apply.
legal.note: Dangerous to set: use setting tongs.

records.coldNote: Under-ice sets work all winter.
records.sustainability: Take no more than about 1–2 beaver per colony per year so the colony survives.

records.name: Foothold traps #1.5–#3 (fox, coyote, wolf)
records.description: For predators and furbearers. Fur has value; meat less so.

legal.consequence: Trapping licence required; restrictions on jaw types and sizes.

records.coldNote: Freezes in snow and rain; bed carefully.

records.name: Box/cage live traps
records.description: Catch and release non-targets. Good near home.

legal.consequence: Small game licence covers hares in box/cage traps; other species need the right licence.

records.name: Trapping kit: setting tongs, stakes, wire, gloves, lure, stretchers
records.description: Support gear for a trapline.

legal.consequence: Legal to own.

records.name: Spinning rod + reel, line, hooks, spoons, jigs
records.description: Pike, walleye, perch, trout in nearly every Shield lake.

legal.consequence: Ontario Outdoors Card + fishing licence. Seasons, limits and sanctuaries apply.

records.coldNote: Line goes brittle in cold.

records.name: Handlines / yo-yo reels + hook assortment
records.description: Tiny, cheap, lasts forever.

legal.consequence: Fishing licence. Line limits apply.

records.name: Ice fishing kit: hand auger, tip-ups, jigging rod, skimmer, ice picks
records.description: Winter protein when hunting is hard. Check ice thickness: 10 cm clear ice minimum on foot.

legal.consequence: Fishing licence; number of lines limited. Some waters closed in winter.

records.coldNote: Hand augers always start.
records.sustainability: Lake trout grow very slowly in cold Shield lakes: a few seasons of heavy harvest can collapse a lake for decades.

records.name: Set lines / trotlines
records.description: Fishes while you work.

legal.consequence: Only allowed in some zones, for some species, with conditions. Illegal elsewhere: fines and gear seizure.
legal.note: Check your Fisheries Management Zone rules.

records.name: Gill net
records.description: Highest-yield fishing tool there is — which is why it is so tightly restricted.

legal.consequence: Illegal for recreational anglers in Ontario: fines, net and boat seizure. Commercial licences and Indigenous treaty rights are separate.
legal.note: Illegal recreational gear.

records.coldNote: Ice-setting nets is slow and hard.
records.maintenance: Mend holes; dry to prevent rot.
records.sustainability: A gill net can empty a small lake in one season. Use large mesh only, avoid spawning areas, rotate lakes, and never leave nets unattended for days.

records.name: Dip net (smelt, baitfish)
records.description: Spring smelt and sucker runs.

legal.consequence: Fishing licence; size and season rules.

records.name: Minnow trap
records.description: Bait for tip-ups and set lines; emergency food.

legal.consequence: Fishing licence. Bait Management Zone rules limit moving baitfish.

records.name: Fish trap / weir
records.description: Passive capture in streams.

legal.consequence: Illegal for recreational use: fines and gear seizure.
legal.note: Illegal recreational method.

records.sustainability: Weirs block spawning runs: never block a full stream.

records.name: Knives: skinning, boning, caping + steel
records.description: Core processing tools.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Bone/meat saw + hatchet
records.description: Moose quarters need a saw.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Game bags (breathable), rope, gambrel, block and tackle
records.description: A moose is 200+ kg of meat: you need to hang it.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Hand meat grinder
records.description: Sausage and burger from tough cuts.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Smoker / smokehouse plan
records.description: Cold-smoking + salt preserves fish and meat without power.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Curing salt (Prague #1 and #2), non-iodized salt
records.description: Nitrite cures prevent botulism in sausages and cured meats. Measure exactly: toxic in excess.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Pressure canner (metal-to-metal seal, no gasket)
records.description: The only safe way to can meat, fish and low-acid vegetables. Gasketless models never need parts.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Canning jars (500 mL and 1 L)
records.description: Reusable for decades.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Canning lids (single-use) + reusable lids
records.description: Single-use lids are the consumable that runs out. Stock several per jar, or reusable lids.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Drying racks / non-electric dehydrator
records.description: Jerky and dried fish.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Bear spray (Health Canada-registered)
records.description: Most effective bear deterrent at close range.

legal.consequence: Legal for defence against animals. Carrying or using it against people makes it a prohibited weapon (Criminal Code offence).

records.coldNote: Weak spray below about −10 °C: keep it inside your jacket.

records.name: Pepper spray for use on people
records.description: Not legal to own for human defence.

legal.consequence: Prohibited weapon in Canada: possession is a Criminal Code offence.

records.name: Air horn / bear bangers / flares
records.description: Scare off animals; signal.

legal.consequence: Legal. Bear bangers are regulated pyrotechnics.

records.name: Guard dog
records.description: Best perimeter alarm ever made; also helps hunting. Needs food and water — add it to your household pets.

legal.consequence: Legal. Local animal bylaws apply.

records.name: Solar motion lights
records.description: Lights up approaches without grid power.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Wireless driveway/perimeter alarm (battery)
records.description: Early warning on approaches and trails.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Door and window reinforcement (strike plates, long screws, bars)
records.description: Hardening buys time.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Binoculars 8×42
records.description: Scouting game and watching approaches. Good glass works at dusk.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Rifle scope (low-power variable, 1–6× or 3–9×)
records.description: Extends ethical range; fogs when moved from warm to cold: let it acclimatize.

legal.consequence: Legal.

records.name: Night vision monocular (Gen 2/3 or digital)
records.description: Watch the perimeter at night.

legal.consequence: Legal to own. Using night vision or lights to hunt is illegal in Ontario except narrow cases.

records.name: Thermal monocular
records.description: Spots people and animals through brush and darkness. Battery hungry in cold.

legal.consequence: Legal to own. Not legal for hunting game at night in Ontario.

records.name: Single-stage reloading press + dies per calibre
records.description: Extends ammo supply; brass can be reloaded many times.

legal.consequence: Legal to own.

records.name: Scale, calipers, case trimmer, priming tool, tumbler, manuals
records.description: Follow published load data exactly.

legal.consequence: Legal to own.

records.name: Smokeless powder
records.description: Shelf life 10+ years sealed, cool, dry. Discard if it smells acrid or shows red dust.

legal.consequence: No licence for personal quantities, but Explosives Regulations limit storage: e.g. 25 kg total propellant in a detached dwelling (max 10 kg black powder), 75 kg smokeless in a detached storage unit, less in apartments. Store away from primers.
legal.note: Check current Explosives Regulations, 2013 limits before stocking up.

records.name: Primers
records.description: The component you cannot make: stock enough for your planned reloads.

legal.consequence: Legal for personal use. Store separately from powder, in original packaging, as the Explosives Regulations require.

records.name: Bullets / cast lead + mould, gas checks
records.description: Casting lets you reuse lead.

legal.consequence: Legal. Lead ammunition is banned for some hunting uses (e.g. waterfowl).
